title: Plot each class model's likelihood history
description: You place stored training histories on one set of labeled axes.

steps.description: You create a figure and visit each class model. ll refers to that model's stored ll_history.
You plot the history and use the class identifier as its legend label. Each pass adds another curve.

steps.question: Does the vertical label describe a per-sequence average or a sum over class sequences?
steps.answer: It describes log-likelihood summed over class sequences. The horizontal label identifies EM iteration.

steps.description: You add labels, title, legend, and layout before requesting the figure. The recording supplies no rendered curves from which to assess convergence.
